rows.name: num_atoms
rows.description: Total bead count; grows by exactly 2*insert_per_step per insert step (the material-supply readout).

rows.name: n_crosslinks
rows.description: NC1/7S crosslink bonds (total minus the CURRENT rod count, so inserted rods' intra-rod bonds are not miscounted); the connectivity readout.

rows.name: crosslink_density
rows.description: Crosslinks per unit (expanded) area = n_crosslinks / (box_xy^2 * (1+strain)^2); the connectivity density that accounts for expansion dilution.

rows.name: sigma_inplane
rows.description: Bond-virial in-plane stress; reported per mode as a supporting readout.

rows.name: largest_connected_network
rows.description: Size of the largest connected component (the exact Fig-2B-C connectivity statistic). Deferred -- density is used as the connectivity proxy here.
